author: Kevin MacLeod
modifications: Re-encoded from the original MP3 to 128 kbps CBR MP3 (44.1 kHz, LAME) for smaller downloads; no edits, cuts or mixing. sha256/bytes describe the original incompetech file; encoded describes the distributed file.

tracks.title: Darkest Child
tracks.description: A childlike celeste plays high notes among a barely audible harp and deep bass. In the second minute the disturbing melody is in a lower register, and strings accentuate the discordant sounds before returning to the high register. The music is excellent for a creepy dream sequence or the exposition of an unknown fantasy world. SMARTSOUND

tracks.title: Long note One
tracks.description: Just a very long pad for use under dialog.

tracks.title: Unseen Horrors
tracks.instruments: Strings, Basses, Cellos, Violins, Brass, Percussion
tracks.description: I originally wrote this as a piece for theramin, but I think it works better without.

tracks.title: Ritual
tracks.instruments: Alto Flute, Bass Flute, Synths, Percussion
tracks.description: Very very slow piece featuring the alto flute.

tracks.title: Gathering Darkness
tracks.description: Screeching dark, electronically chattery. Nightmarish.

tracks.title: The Dread
tracks.description: Background horror music. Electronic. Slow, rumbly, and whiny Moderately unnerving.

tracks.title: Dark Walk
tracks.description: Simple motive countered by several striking dissonances.

tracks.title: Evening of Chaos
tracks.instruments: Piano, Percussion, Synths, Strings, Brass, Glockenspiel
tracks.description: Semi-beautiful and flawed piano melody contrasts with industrial percussion.

tracks.title: Danse Macabre
tracks.description: Written by Saint Saens in 1874. This is a quite well known and epic piece of music.

tracks.title: Echoes of Time
tracks.description: Deep, rich, and thick soundscape with semi-tonal bells.

tracks.title: Long Note Two
tracks.description: Heavy effects on an arhythmic piano, and very deep bass.

tracks.title: Ghost Processional
tracks.instruments: Double Bass, Cello, Violin, Celesta, Bells
tracks.description: Scant few cellos and bassists play pizzicato under celesta, bells, and violins in this slow and careful piece. The extra string tag on the end is not intended as part of the piece, it is included for use stand-alone in foreshadowing in video editing.

tracks.title: Ossuary 6 - Air
tracks.description: Well, something has taken a turn for the not-quite-as-good-as-I'd-like. Slow-moving drone of impending doom!

tracks.title: Deadly Roulette
tracks.instruments: Drums, Bass, Synth Bass, Guitar, Vibraphone, Percussion
tracks.description: Jazzy! Gumshoe-y! Mystery-y! I suck at making adjectives. Who needs adjectives anyway! I'm fine without adjectives. How fine without adjectives, you may ask? I can't say - as that would require some sort of descriptor! And I don't need descriptors in my writings... Maybe one... tiny little... NO! What am I thinking!? I refuse! I've completely had it with adjectives! Hah! Adverbs work perfectly fine! Woohoo! Adverbs! And before I get mail... adjectives killed my family, so I can go off on them all I want.

tracks.title: Dances and Dames
tracks.instruments: Bass, Drum Kit, Electric Piano, Voice
tracks.description: Off-center feeling film noir-like piece with a continually changing time signature. "Something is amiss on the streets. My job is to figure that out."

tracks.title: Chase Pulse
tracks.description: Measured pace in low registers that just doesn't stop.

tracks.title: Shadowlands 5 - Antechamber
tracks.description: Part five of seven. Airy, but not in the "I'm outdoors, and everything is great 'airy'" way. More like the "the alien machine that sustains our life is slowly breaking down and poison is beginning to seep from its core" way. Whatever is happening... it isn't fast, and it isn't good.

tracks.title: Final Battle of the Dark Wizards
tracks.filename: Final Battle of the Dark Wizards.mp3

tracks.title: Ice Demon
tracks.description: Hollow creepy background pad. This is not the feel-good hit of the summer. It is more like the cheese-grater to the brain of uncomfortableness.

tracks.title: Bent and Broken
tracks.description: More soundscape than music. Ideal for all of your zombie, horror, paranormal needs.

tracks.title: Awkward Meeting
tracks.description: Simple piano theme drives this, but it sometimes buried under unnerving textures. 7/4 time, rubato.
tracks.feel: Dark, Eerie, Intense, Mysterious, Mystical, Suspenseful, Unnerving

tracks.title: Distant Tension
tracks.description: Background horror music. Symphonic with some digital processing. Some tremolo basses in the beginning are meant to be removed and integrated on their own.

tracks.title: Deep Haze
tracks.description: A lighter piece than the descriptors would imply. It is more hollow than dark, more motion-forward than driving. Builds continuously but slowly.

tracks.title: Dark Times
tracks.description: Deeply troubling and somber, this piece is heavy on the bass strings, especially in the last minute. The feel is very dark and funereal, and could be used to depict the beginning of the apocalypse.

tracks.title: Night of Chaos
tracks.description: The mellow guitar lulls you on a superficial level, while being undermined by the synths.

tracks.title: Darkness is Coming
tracks.description: Quiet yet epic. This piece is an odd mix. Highly processed drum kit.

tracks.title: Hitman
tracks.description: Extension of a piece I wrote for Bite Sized Minecraft 2. Super-produced. Super awesome.

tracks.title: Clash Defiant
tracks.instruments: Basses, Cellos, War Horn, Brass, Percussion, Choir
tracks.description: You want battle music? You can't HANDLE the battle music! Meh. You probably can. As battle music goes, this is pretty tame - no blaring trumpets or hyperactive xylophones... Why? Dialog! You can actually talk over this battle music! Feel free to punctuate with your own stabs after you cut around your dialog. Or don't. You can use this as a loop on your Twitch stream for anything... battle-y. That rough spiccato bass line is off the hook! (Do people still say "off the hook"? I might be a few years late on that.)  .

tracks.title: Dark Fog
tracks.description: The title refers to a state of mind more than a physical thing. That sort of feeling you get when there are choices to be made... none of them very good ones.

tracks.title: Hush
tracks.description: Creepy little piece with a buildup and action hit around 1:30.

tracks.title: Oppressive Gloom
tracks.description: Moody moody dark score. Almost a death march. Loops pretty darned well - but you need to trim the end.
tracks.feel: Dark, Eerie, Epic, Mysterious, Somber, Suspenseful

tracks.title: Anxiety
tracks.description: Background horror music. Electronic.

tracks.title: The Descent
tracks.instruments: French Horns, Trombones, Tuba, Violins, Percussion, Trumpet
tracks.description: Driving piece without an overpowering melody. Should fit nicely into a lot of scenes.

tracks.title: Stormfront
tracks.description: Intense and reserved, this unrelenting piece of drumming will be well at home in the soundtrack of your summer blockbuster. Super long for splicing.

tracks.title: Despair and Triumph
tracks.description: Very moody digitally altered piano.

tracks.title: Moorland
tracks.description: It has Uilleann pipes, and is dark and somber. Not sure what else I can say about this.

tracks.title: Spacial Winds
tracks.description: Clear bowed-bell theme over a sweeping dark digital pad.

tracks.title: Inexorable
tracks.description: Highly processed and oddly played piano makes up the harmonic base of this piece. Sort sort of ticking clock thing... This is a brash mix, but probably not as bad as you think!

tracks.title: Day of Chaos
tracks.instruments: Piano, Percussion, Synths, Strings, Brass, Glockenspiel
tracks.description: Abrasive upright piano sets the tone for this start-stop horror suspense piece.

tracks.title: Darkening Developments
tracks.instruments: Percussion, Synth Bass, Bass Section, Oboe, Bassoon, Clarinet, Piccolo
tracks.description: Bass is very VERY strong in this. Please make sure you master on a system capable of reproducing these notes. The end feel is decided different from the rest of the piece. It does an unnerving build to nowhere.

tracks.title: Evening Fall (Harp)
tracks.description: Harp "duet"... where the harps never actually play together. Impromptu

tracks.title: Lost Time
tracks.description: Is someone dying onscreen, but you still need some dialog so you can't go up against a solo oboe (the universal musical shorthand for death scenes)? We got this! Dark and moving, this piece will make you cry and not get in the way of those final bits of dialog! Also useful for sullen montage sequences of clergy activities.

tracks.title: Crossing the Chasm
tracks.instruments: Drums, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins, Singer
tracks.description: Adventure, Ho! Last time on "Adventure, Ho!", the mage-orc Gnarlnosh was granted 1d4 wishes from a Deck of Many Things and it totally screwed up the game balance. Why? Because the DM sort of sucks, but he thought "Oh, sure - this could be fun... how could giving a mage-orc a fully provisioned army in the middle of a desert possibly sidetrack the quest for finding a cure for a magical disease that is ruining the kingdom AND the healer elf." Deck of Many Things; BAH! More like Deck of This-Campaign-Jumped-the-Shark.

tracks.title: Long Road Ahead B
tracks.description: Same as "Long Road Ahead", but without the final triumphant section.

tracks.title: Spacial Harvest
tracks.description: Deep unsettling piece with no repeated themes. Fat, rounded bass drone with very high pitched interest on top.

tracks.title: Shadowlands 3 - Machine
tracks.description: Part three of seven. Part pipe organ, part broken pipe organ, this isn't just spooky, it is crazy spooky. It also has a musical theme, which not all of this horror moody stuff has. Consider it the jelly filling in your horror doughnut.

tracks.title: SCP-x2x (Unseen Presence)
tracks.description: Dark horror soundscape. There are places of evil in the world. Dark places. There are places that absorb life with their greasy tendrils of unlight. There are places that screw up everyone's sandwiches. There are places that delay postal packages. There are places that cause internet outages right when you're down to the last 4 players in an online 1 vs 100 Tetris tournament. There are places of evil in the world. Dark places.

tracks.title: SCP-x4x (Mind Leech)
tracks.description: Grating Horror Soundscape. Welcome to the Open House! I’m Kathy, your realtor. You’ll probably want to keep your shoes on. On your left is the living room, complete with ornate working fireplace. It’s fueled by the souls of the damned AND it heats the whole house! Mind yourself around the walls, they can get a little grabby if they haven’t been fed yet. Up the stairs and to your right is piece de resistance... the jacuzzi tub! The water filtration system gets out most of the blood. Now, about the attic...

tracks.title: Black Vortex
tracks.instruments: Cimbasso, Tuba, Trombones, French Horns, Trumpets, Basses, Cellos, Violas, Violins, Clarinet, Flute, Synths
tracks.description: Orchestral hybrid piece in 7/8 time. This one starts slow and bold, and ramps into fast and furious with an unrelenting melody.
tracks.feel: Action, Aggressive, Dark, Driving, Epic, Intense, Suspenseful

tracks.title: The Complex
tracks.description: Mechanistic, electronic and organic. This piece gets very big around 1:46. (The preview is more 'boomy' than the download.)
tracks.feel: Action, Aggressive, Dark, Driving, Epic, Intense, Mysterious
